part2.question: Describe a person you know who is very organised

segments.v: I want to talk about my mother. She is a very organised person. She is an accountant. She always writes everything in her planner. She has a calendar on the fridge and she writes the plans of our family on it. She uses different colours for each person. Every Sunday she makes a plan for the next week. I noticed this when we prepare for Tết. She makes a list one month before Tết and she finishes everything early. Also, when we moved house, she organised everything very well. I think being organised is important to her because she is very busy. She works full-time and she takes care of two children. If she is not organised, she will be very stressed. I want to be organised like her.

fluency.band6: Correct information but short sentences; two grammar errors.
fluency.band9: Who → specific systems (planner, colour-coded calendar, Sunday planning) → two real situations → a deeper reason → personal effect.

lexical.band9: precision, colour-coded, chaos, in advance, coordinated, on her plate, overwhelmed, peace of mind.

grammar.band6: Errors: tense mismatch (“I noticed this when we prepare”); conditional (“If she is not organised, she will be…” → If she weren't…, she'd be…).
grammar.band9: Passive list (the house is cleaned, the gifts are wrapped…), “from… to…”, second conditional (without a system, she'd be…), and emphatic “does” (it really does help).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 errors: “I noticed this when we prepare for Tết” mixes tenses (when we prepared / whenever we prepare); “If she is not organised, she will be…” should be second conditional (If she weren't organised, she'd be…). Band 9 gives specific systems, two real situations, and a deeper reason.
